# Falcons Education System

> Private school in Rawalpindi, Pakistan, teaching Play Group to Class 6, with
> Montessori early years and an Evening Coaching Academy (Mon–Sat, 3:30–7:00 PM)
> that coaches children from Play Group up to Matric — from any school — plus
> Spoken English and computer courses for children.

Key facts:
- Location: Street No 14, Sonari Bank, Kamalabad Road, Near Bakra Mandi, Rawalpindi, Punjab, Pakistan 46000
- Founded: August 2024
- School ages: 3 to 12 years (Play Group, Nursery, KG, then Class 1–6)
- School hours: Monday–Thursday & Saturday 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM; Friday 8:00 AM – 12:30 PM
- Coaching Academy: Play Group to Matric, Monday–Saturday 3:30–7:00 PM, open to children from any school
- Small class sizes; teachers known for individual attention
- Admissions: open for Session 2026, via WhatsApp +92 311 9911288 or phone 051-6129955
- Email: falconseducationsystem@gmail.com
- Website: https://falconseducationsystem.com
